searchText: I've started another round of heavy spamming on devnet-7 will leave it running 24 hours seems to have taken besu nodes out <https://dora.glamsterdam-devnet-7.ethpandaops.io/> cc <@764128349488152606> > besu: world state never persisted after block import — regression in `16c6fae77` "Stateroot modification glamsterdam devnet 7" > + (#10869); 4/6 prod besu nodes wedged (NOT caused by the spam increase) Yes, I just saw that, I have a node running with the previous commit without issues. <@680337202521440470> could you take a look ? Could you rollback to ethpandaops/besu:glamsterdam-devnet-7-caa5abf while investigating from our side ? rolled back. The database is corrupted, we need to resync the nodes. ok lighthouse-besu-1 is sync'ing yeah kicked all of them hmm might need some fancy assertoor logic for this but it could be doable Seems mostly teku is still self building even though they should have a higher bid from buildoor <@993802539856314398> I'm trying to win and withold every 31st slot why slot 31 btw? what exactly do you wanna test? that was suggested as a test vector here but I guess you'd want the whole slot missing not just the payload? yeah whole slot missing is important so that the dependent root is actually not slot 31 so blocks in slot 31 being reorged should trigger some untested paths I don't really see what the payload missing would do, it has no impact on epoch transition (thanks to 5094) but slot 31 being reorged is nasty, but also clients don't do this today even if head is weak
